turns.question: At which hour of the day were the most page views recorded between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many page views were in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric or hour-of-day grain that answers this: page views can only be counted per day (metric_time__day), not per hour, so I cannot say which hour had the most page views between 20 September and 3 October 2026. The closest metrics are customer_actions (filtered to action type page_view) and site_sessions (sessions with a page view), both by day.
